claims: In croquet, mallets are used to strike balls through metal hoops or wickets.
Croquet wickets are often called hoops.
Croquet wickets are set into holes in the lawn.
Croquet wickets are typically spaced three to five meters apart.
Croquet wickets are spaced in a 6 or 9-wicket double-diamond pattern.
Croquet wickets are placed on a flat short-mown lawn.
Croquet wickets must be secure in their holes.
The gap between the uprights of croquet wickets should be 3 11/16ths of an inch.
The objective of croquet is to navigate the course passing the ball through the wickets in the correct order.
6-wicket setups are common for a quick game in croquet.
9-wicket setups are used for different variations of croquet.
The final goal in 9-wicket croquet setups is the central peg.
The term wicket is used in croquet.
The term wicket is used in cricket.
